attributes.name: HipsName
attributes.helptext: The root-most joint that is allowed to translate that is used for character height control. Height control increases the range of motion of the leg IK, allowing it to adapt better to uneven surfaces.

attributes.name: HipsHeightControlEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables character height control.

attributes.name: HipsPosVelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables velocity clamping of the vertical character height control.

attributes.name: HipsPosVelLimit
attributes.helptext: The velocity limit of the character height control (in leg lengths per second).

attributes.name: HipsPosAccelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables acceleration clamping of the vertical character height control motion.

attributes.name: HipsPosAccelLimit
attributes.helptext: The acceleration limit of the character height control (in leg lengths per second^2).

attributes.name: BallJointEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables the use of a specified ball joint. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: ToeJointEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables the use of a specified ball joint. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: StraightestLegFactor
attributes.helptext: How straight the leg is allowed to become, as a fraction of the fully straightened (hip, knee and ankle all lined up). When the foot lifting target is out of reach, the leg will go straight and this can look unnatural.

attributes.name: LeftAnkleName
attributes.helptext: The name of the left ankle joint.

attributes.name: LeftBallName
attributes.helptext: An optional joint to specify the ball of the foot. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: LeftToeName
attributes.helptext: An optional joint to specify the toe of the foot. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: LeftKneeRotationAxisX
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: LeftKneeRotationAxisY
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: LeftKneeRotationAxisZ
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: LeftFlipKneeRotationDirection
attributes.helptext: Change the sign of the knee axis, which will flip its bending direction.

attributes.name: LeftEventTrackID
attributes.helptext: An integer identifying the footfall event track ID for this leg. Only duration events on the specified track will be used for foot plant prediction.

attributes.name: RightAnkleName
attributes.helptext: The name of the right ankle joint.

attributes.name: RightBallName
attributes.helptext: An optional joint to specify the ball of the foot. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: RightToeName
attributes.helptext: An optional joint to specify the toe of the foot. The footbase pivot is determined from the centroid of the foot joints. This point is lifted onto the terrain surface.

attributes.name: RightKneeRotationAxisX
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: RightKneeRotationAxisY
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: RightKneeRotationAxisZ
attributes.helptext: The axis to rotate the knee joint around, in the coordinate frame of its parent.

attributes.name: RightFlipKneeRotationDirection
attributes.helptext: Change the sign of the knee axis, which will flip its bending direction.

attributes.name: RightEventTrackID
attributes.helptext: An integer identifying the footfall event track ID for this leg. Only duration events on the specified track will be used for foot plant prediction.

attributes.name: AnklePosVelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables velocity clamping for the vertical foot lifting of the ankle joint.

attributes.name: AnklePosVelLimit
attributes.helptext: The velocity limit of the ankle joint foot lifting (in leg lengths per second).

attributes.name: AnklePosAccelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables acceleration clamping for the vertical foot lifting of the ankle joint.

attributes.name: AnklePosAccelLimit
attributes.helptext: The acceleration limit of the ankle joint foot lifting (in leg lengths per second^2).

attributes.name: AnkleAngVelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables velocity clamping for the ankle joint surface orientation alignment.

attributes.name: AnkleAngVelLimit
attributes.helptext: The velocity limit of the ankle joint surface orientation alignment (revolutions per second).

attributes.name: AnkleAngAccelLimitEnable
attributes.helptext: Enables acceleration clamping for the ankle joint surface orientation alignment.

attributes.name: AnkleAngAccelLimit
attributes.helptext: The acceleration limit of the ankle joint surface orientation alignment (revolutions per second^2).

attributes.name: UseGroundPenetrationFixup
attributes.helptext: If turned on prevents the foot penetrating onto the surface if the foot is moving downward from above with large velocity.

attributes.name: UseTrajectorySlopeAlignment
attributes.helptext: Consider vertical trajectory motion of the input source when computing foot lifting and surface alignment.

attributes.name: FootAlignToSurfaceAngleLimit
attributes.helptext: The maximum terrain surface angle limit (in degrees) that the foot can be aligned with. Foot alignment is clamped to this limit.

attributes.name: FootAlignToSurfaceMaxSlopeAngle
attributes.helptext: The maximum terrain slope gradient limit (in degrees) that is considered for foot alignment. The foot is aligned back to the ground plane if beyond this limit.

attributes.name: FootLiftingHeightLimit
attributes.helptext: The maximum height from the character root to the ankle joint that the foot can be lifted to (in leg lengths).

attributes.name: PredictionSlopeAngleLimit
attributes.helptext: The maximum foot lifting slope angle (in degrees) to the predicted foot plant positions on the terrain surface.

attributes.name: PredictionLateralAngleLimit
attributes.helptext: The maximum lateral angle limit (in degrees) for mantaining the cache of predicted terrain data. The conical section defined by the angle limit is used to invalidate terrain data due to abrupt changes in trajectory.

attributes.name: PredictionCloseFootbaseTolFrac
attributes.helptext: A tolerance distance (in leg lengths) used to determine if the current foot position is close to its predicted estimate.

helptext: Predictive Uneven Terrain: Lifts and aligns the feet of the character with the environment.
